description: Change a written article's title, meta title (60 characters at most) or meta description (155 at most). The article's URL does not change. Defaults to a DRY RUN describing what would happen. When the person asked for this, call it with confirm=true. On a published article the change also goes to the customer's site.

confirm.description: Set true to actually save (default: dry run)

metaDescription.description: New meta description, 155 characters at most

metaTitle.description: New meta title, 60 characters at most

name: update_article_meta
